author: EmuCore - Hub
title: PCSX2 1.7x Save States & Hotkeys  | Early 2023 Update
summary: Sonar Systems demonstrates the PCSX2 1.7 save-state and hotkey interface, giving a focused look at quick session snapshots while leaving room to distinguish convenience states from durable in-game memory-card saves.

blocks.text: The short tutorial concentrates on two connected workflow tools: save states capture emulator execution at a moment, and hotkeys make creating or loading those slots practical without leaving gameplay. This is useful for testing difficult sequences, comparing settings from the same starting point or resuming a short session. Because the upload identifies the 1.7 development line, viewers can place the menu and bindings in a specific interface generation instead of assuming the same labels exist in every PCSX2 release.

A save state serializes emulator internals and may become incompatible after core changes; it is not a substitute for the game’s own memory-card format or an external backup. Loading the wrong slot can also discard newer progress. The description provides no cross-version migration test, slot-retention model or controller-specific mapping. Learn the current hotkey names in PCSX2, preserve normal saves, copy memory cards separately and label test states by game revision. Use states as disposable checkpoints, especially when changing emulator builds or accuracy settings.
